notes: Counts come from the script, not from this file; the notes record callers a reader would not guess.
tools/solo_selfplay.gd (the headless harness that drove the table directly) was deleted by P4.D-39; tools/arena_match.gd plays through the game loop and its core door.
test/parity/parity_table.gd:114 calls _solo_resolve_ai_volley directly; test/parity/parity_table_melee.gd:66 calls _run_ai_melee (P4.D-38 moves both parity harnesses).
_solo_volley_outcome has no prod caller outside main.gd since P4.D-41: the sentence moved into CoreActivation.volley_outcome and this function only delegates (the core path shows it).

A listed caller that disappears is fine on purpose; only an unlisted NEW prod caller turns --check red. To allow one, add 'file:function' to allowed_callers of the callee in the same diff as a plan step that says so.
Whole-file entries (planner groups) are not gated and keep the counter; planner_tags tags every column-0 function of the 7 planner files; a new planner function must get a tag in the same diff.

Tags: erlkoenig = needed by the Rust search hand-off (_core_plan: capture, state_to_plain, AiPlanner statics, act recorder); live_helper = live game logic that is not search (mission scoring); table_live = still called by a main.gd function that survives the table deletion; tree = decision tree / AiPosition; gd_search = the GDScript search (reached on a core decline or in debug/test defaults; includes its profiling marks); table_dead = dies with the table deletion (a function that gd_search also calls dies with the later of the table deletion and the search deletion); tools_only / test_only = no prod caller; dead = no caller.
